title: Note Rehearsal Router
user: A self-learner with a markdown note graveyard who wants a saved idea to become one concrete recall, solve, or explain action.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension plus local markdown folder watcher: present one untriaged note at a time and create exactly one local recall, solve, teach, do, or archive ticket.
success_measure: For users importing 30+ notes, 30% convert at least ten notes into completed rehearsal actions within 14 days.
constraints: Filesystem permission and data stay local; markdown parsing is non-destructive; clear uninstall/export; no page-reading permissions.
